info.name: Lao Captions API
info.description:
Go Gin service that runs lao_caption.py (Whisper + Lao wav2vec2 + SEA-LION via Ollama) and burns Lao captions into a video.

Flow: 1. Create job → 2. Get job (repeat until status = review) → 3. Get/fix captions → 4. Burn → 5. Get job (until done) → 6. Download video.

Create job saves the new id into {{jobId}} automatically. Set {{apiKey}} only if the server runs with API_KEY.

request.description: Checks python, lao_caption.py, ffmpeg and the Ollama model. 200 = ready, 503 = something is missing (see checks).

formdata.description: What the video is about. Helps the LLM.
true = burn straight away, skip review
true = after burning, save clips to dataset\ and examples.jsonl

request.description: Uploads a video and queues it. Returns 202 with the job. Click the 'video' row and choose a file before sending.

status: queued → transcribing → review → burning → done (or failed / canceled).
stage: whisper → wav2vec2 → llm → burn → collect.
log has the last lines from the Python script.
Stops a queued or running job.
Cancels the job and deletes its files. Returns 204.
Captions as JSON. 'lao' is the caption; 'whisper' and 'w2v' are the raw guesses the LLM used; llm_ok=false means the LLM failed on that line. Returns 409 until status = review.

Replaces ALL captions. Tip: copy the 'segments' array from Get segments, fix the 'lao' text, and send it back (whisper/w2v/llm_ok fields are ignored).

sfx (optional): sound played when the caption appears. See 'List sound effects' for the names.
style (optional): saves the caption look on the job (same keys as Burn captions).
Names you can use as a caption's sfx. Hear one at {{baseUrl}}/sfx/pop.wav
Loudness peaks (0-1) and duration, for drawing a timeline.
The current .lo.srt file. Use Send and Download to save it.
Replaces the captions with an SRT you edited elsewhere (e.g. Subtitle Edit). Paste the whole file as the body.

Queues the burn (returns 202). Poll Get job until status = done.

collect=true also saves the corrected clips as training data.

style (all keys optional; omit style to reuse the job's last one):
- size: font size, % of video height (1.5-12, default 3.7)
- position: gap from the bottom, % of video height (2-60, default 13)
- color / outline_color: "#RRGGBB" (default white / black)
- animation: none | fade | pop | slide (default none)
- anim_ms: animation length in ms (50-2000, default 300)
- sfx_volume: sound effect loudness 0-2 (default 1)
- max_lines: longer captions are shown as pages of this many lines (1-6, default 2)

Sound effects set on captions (Update segments) are mixed into the audio.
The finished .captioned.mp4. Use Send and Download to save it. Returns 409 until status = done.
